## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

WaitingForPhoneViewModel — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/waitingforphone/WaitingForPhoneViewModel.kt

## Trigger

The profile flow emitting a profile with a non-null `lastSyncSuccessAt`, in `WaitingForPhoneViewModel.init`'s collection of `profileRepository.observe()` — observed

## Today

`WaitingForPhoneViewModel.init` collects `profileRepository.observe()` and,
once a profile carries a non-null `lastSyncSuccessAt`, sets
`hasReceivedProfile = true` on its own `uiState`. Nothing reads that
field: `WaitingForPhoneScreen`/`MainActivity` render whatever destination
`WatchRaceNavigator.current` holds, and no method of `WatchRaceNavigator`
moves it out of `WAITING_FOR_PHONE` — `onSensorPermissionResolved` only
leaves `SENSOR_PERMISSION`, and every other method guards on a different
current destination. The user only reaches the home screen by restarting
the application, which re-evaluates `profileAlreadySynced` at construction.

## Expected

`WaitingForPhoneViewModel` calls a navigator method once the profile
carries a non-null `lastSyncSuccessAt`, the same way `SensorPermissionViewModel`
calls `navigator.onSensorPermissionResolved()` on its own resolution —
so `WaitingForPhoneViewModel` needs `WatchRaceNavigator` injected, which
it does not receive today.

Second gap: `WatchRaceNavigator` carries no method that leaves
`WAITING_FOR_PHONE`. One is needed — analogous to
`onSensorPermissionResolved()` — that sets `current` to `HOME` when it is
called while `current` is `WAITING_FOR_PHONE`, and is a no-op otherwise.
